'''Vivatherin''' was a type of chemical used by the pawns of [[Cronal]]. It was used to revive unconscious individuals in mere minutes by using a [[chromostring]] to inject the drug.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
